evidence: We use, and intend on continuing to expand our use of, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to deliver our services and operate our business, including to optimize our operations, improve efficiency, and enhance customer solutions across our global logistics network.
This technology incorporates dynamic data science, predictive analytics and machine learning to aid decision-making.

Our intelligent warehouse automation includes deployments of autonomous robots and collaborative robots (cobots), automated sortation systems, automated guided vehicles, goods-to-person systems and wearable devices.
Our warehouse management systems create a synchronized environment across automation platforms to control these technologies holistically, providing an integrated solution.
Our use of AI subjects us to risks related to accuracy, intellectual property infringement or misappropriation, data privacy, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance, among others.
ai_positioning.summary: GXO intègre l'IA et le machine learning dans ses opérations logistiques internes (gestion du travail, analytique prédictive, automatisation d'entrepôt) sans développer de modèles propriétaires à vendre, tout en reconnaissant les risques réglementaires et de sécurité associés.
